note: cm->cur_frame is set to point to the frame buffer at cm->new_fb_idx before OBU decoding begins
ref_cnt_fb changes cm->new_fb_idx to frame_to_show and decrements the old buffer's ref_count, but cm->cur_frame still points to the old buffer
reset_decoder_state is set to true because the referenced frame is a KEY_FRAME
show_existing_frame_reset is called when reset_decoder_state is true

WRITE to cm->cur_frame->intra_only on the stale pointer; cm->cur_frame still references the old buffer whose ref_count was decremented by ref_cnt_fb, causing a heap-use-after-free write of 1 byte (uint8_t)
